edition: Paderewski / Bronarski / Turczynski (PWM): model-reviewed pitches, attacks, rhythm and dynamic levels; not a facsimile edition
provenance: Derived from the exact cached Noctave CC0 encoding, corrected by a complete model scan audit against Paderewski Minor Works PDF pp.43-45; original encoding retained separately
licence: Source MusicXML rights: Noctave edition, CC0 1.0 https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/ ; based on MuseScore 5615774; source https://noctavepiano.com/partitions/chopin-nocturne-b49/ . Derived corrections are separate from the original and no scan is redistributed.
verified_scope: written grace notes and trill symbols
both staves and cross-staff passage at 45
constant dynamic levels and tempo words
omitted_or_unverified_scope: variable trill realization and performed cadenza timing
corrections: Remove Noctave’s extra three-note lead-ins before the trills in printed 5, 13 and 47; retain the actual written two/four-note trill endings.
Restore the missing C#5/D#5 small-note pair before the whole-note trill in printed 57.

Correct the 17-note runs in printed 15, 49 and 53: two groups of eighth-note triplets, two ordinary sixteenths, then three groups of sixteenth-note triplets. The source uses a quintuplet and sextuplet for the last eleven notes.
Split the source’s combined 5/4 bar 32 into the printed 2/4 bar 32 and 3/4 bar 33; renumber every following measure, giving 65 printed bars including the final whole-note chord.
Remove source fermatas in the new printed bar 33, absent from this scan; retain the printed fermatas at 46 and 65.
Preserve all final 18-, 35-, 11- and 13-note flourishes and their sounding octaves; mark cadenza-like measures exempt from a metronomic timing comparison using fingerprinted review metadata.
Add scan-reviewed p/pp/f/ppp levels at their written positions and tempo/expressive words; preserve independent LH voices and the cross-staff Adagio arpeggio.
